result: Negative result confirmed: the strategy advice's log-height estimator (expected_bound=3.7) is an incompatible theoretical baseline for GNFS polynomial selection. The correct coefficient bound B=N^(1/(d+1)) for N=100003, degree=5 is 10.0001, and the strategy's "10%-tolerance" framing does not correspond to any known GNFS normalization. The strategy-advised polynomial passes the coefficient bound check (max_coeff=2 < B=10.0001) but fails the log-height comparison by 2.7x. The R3 test (genus-6 plane quintic curves, Riemann-Roch) remains deferred per accepted_continuation — it requires Sage/Magma or function-field algebra tools not available in pure Python.
next_gate: When Sage/Magma or equivalent algebraic geometry tools become available: execute the R3 test per accepted_continuation.next_gate (construct d=5 genus-6 plane quintic curves, measure Riemann-Roch divisor extraction effect on relation heights).
